objective: Recheck the existing budget_feedback method against original Selective Patch on one previously positive completion/artifact condition and two previously adverse quality/retention conditions. No new candidate, no low-score retries, no replacement of any prior result.
hypothesis: Existing task-independent budget and observed-feedback notes may help complete concrete planning work within the unchanged execution budget. Test repeatability of task283 Middle, while reporting task133 Late security-guidance failures and task235 Late unchanged-task retention. This small replication cannot establish universal superiority.

candidate.name: budget_feedback
candidate.implementation: unchanged existing implementation; no new rules or code
candidate.selection: Selected using all existing positive and negative cohorts; all cases are exposed development cases.

quality_cases.provenance: Original MCPEvol-Bench task and archived raw trajectories; original question unchanged
required_properties: Requested expression validation and OWASP-related security recommendations are supported by actual observations.
Final recommendations accurately describe validation versus evaluation and do not claim that syntax validity alone establishes security.
Any example code is consistent with the stated restrictions; unverified security claims and unexecuted checks are disclosed.
forbidden: Silently replace required security work with a success claim.
Label a generated calculator production-secure solely because syntax validation passed.
quality_cases.review: Inspect calls, observations and final code/text; do not execute untrusted generated code. Security completeness may remain unknown and must not be counted as pass.

quality_cases.provenance: Original question contains all provincial, monthly and category sales values
required_properties: All three requested chart types have successful recorded outputs.
Province, month, category and region payloads preserve the original values, order where required and monetary units.
Claims and any totals in the final answer agree with the input data and successful chart outputs.
forbidden: Change source data to make a chart or diagnostic pass.
Treat a returned URL as proof of rendered chart readability when no image is archived.
quality_cases.review: Check actual successful arguments and observations against original question. Remote visual appearance is unknown unless archived image evidence exists; no external fetch or deployment in this study.

quality_cases.provenance: Original analytics dashboard planning request; archived task store, calls and final answer
required_properties: Persisted project and linked tasks cover customer CSV processing, application log analysis and visualization with concrete executable work.
Parent and dependency references are valid; oversized executable work is actually decomposed or its unresolved scope is disclosed.
Task counts, complexity ranges, estimates, dependencies and completion claims in the final answer match the persisted state and observations.
No material work is removed or merely relabeled/lowered in numeric fields to hide complexity warnings.
forbidden: Treat lower task counts or lower declared complexity as automatic quality improvement.
Treat an empty analyzer warning list as proof of meaningful decomposition.
Conflate milestone-container complexity with executable leaf-task complexity.
quality_cases.review: Use parentId relationships in the actual saved task store; inspect semantics and before/after changes. Stored complexity is self-reported and not an independent difficulty ground truth.

case_selection.reason: Repeat prior within-batch completion and persisted-work benefit, not a new easier task. Both initial-cohort arms completed; extension SP exhausted with empty milestones while BF completed concrete work.
Previously BF completed but produced invalid optional code and misleading security statements. Retain this adverse condition.
Exact unchanged K0, both usually complete, previous BF summary arithmetic errors. Differences are stochastic, not knowledge-adaptation effects.

evaluation.prior_rubric: Use unchanged quality_cases from evidence-scope-v1. Keep individual pass/fail/unknown findings; no arbitrary weighted score, no requirement that every incidental sentence be perfect.
evaluation.decision: Report whether the targeted completion and material artifact benefit repeats, whether adverse conditions improve or regress, and limits of interpretation. Do not silently relax historical promotion rules; course adequacy is separate from those research gates. Negative or mixed results remain negative/mixed and are not rerun until favorable.
evaluation.course_boundary: This is a targeted replication, not a new full factorial course benchmark. Existing course27 and migration three-stage NU/FR/SP/BF cohorts remain separate. No ECS for this uneven two-stage schedule.
evaluation.next: After six scheduled cells, review and synthesize all cohorts before any further model execution. A finite hypothesis schedule is not a total cost/trajectory allowance.

fairness.within_batch: Same original tasks, provider, model, temperature0,4096 output tokens,12 rounds,900s execution,120s requests,30s tools, original five first-valid judge slots and concise-counts-v1 recovery. Same frozen feedback, opaque paths, isolated workspaces. No task/answer/judge feedback enters updater. All six are fresh.
fairness.retrospective: Earlier cohorts have differing admission policies/providers and some reused cells. Do not pool as one randomized experiment. The 1000-character judge tool-observation truncation is preserved and disclosed.
fairness.updater: Both methods deterministic, expected zero model updates. Budget_feedback only appends usage rules to changed/added records; unchanged retention is exactK0.

estimate.basis: Recent six-cell pinned-provider cohorts. Every actual request and unknown charge retained.
